basic_info.description: 318 Madrid Street, San Francisco - A stunning blend of classic charm and modern updates, this home showcases gorgeous period details alongside contemporary finishes. The spacious kitchen features updated cabinetry, stone counters, tile flooring, and stainless steel appliances. The inviting dining room, with elegant wainscoting and a coved ceiling, is perfect for gatherings, while the sunlit living room boasts an original fireplace for cozy evenings. Two generous bedrooms, a beautifully remodeled bath, and a laundry room complete the main level.    Designed for California living, the custom backyard features a multi-level patio and professional hardscaping ideal for entertaining. Throughout, preserved woodwork and exquisite craftsmanship add to the home's undeniable character. A rare find that seamlessly blends history, style, and possibility!
